name: professor-course-design-skills
description: Design and review aligned courses at selectable depth using the Professor DataLayer course structure.

interface.shortDescription: Turn outcomes into aligned concepts, weeks, assessments, and a project spine.
interface.longDescription: Two focused skills create and review courses at SKETCH, STANDARD, or ASSURANCE depth. The workflow starts from observable performance, decomposes it into capabilities and concepts, sequences prerequisites, maps I/R/M/A progression, and aligns assessment and project evidence. STANDARD output follows the sibling Professor DataLayer course-tree contract. No CLI, runtime dependency, database, or mandatory research pass is required.
defaultPrompt: Design a 15-week course from these outcomes at STANDARD depth.
Sketch a short course on retrieval-augmented generation.
Review this syllabus for alignment and sequencing gaps.
Build an approval-first course map with a final project spine.
